articles.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump's Mail Ballot Restrictions Before Midterms
articles.summary: The Supreme Court rejected President Trump's attempt to restrict mail ballots just before the November midterms. The ruling lets states keep their existing mail voting systems, which account for nearly a third of all U.S. votes.

articles.title: Trump's EPA Repeals Greenhouse Gas Limits on Power Plants
articles.summary: The EPA is repealing limits on greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuel power plants, calling it the largest deregulatory action in U.S. power sector history. Environmental groups say they will challenge the decision in court.

articles.title: Trump Administration Suffers Double Legal Setback Over Immigration Rules
articles.summary: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from imposing time limits on student and journalist visas. Meanwhile, 22 states sued to stop a rule that would deny green cards to immigrants who use public benefits.
